ui.pageDescription: Panel port, remote access, server integrations, backups, and security.
ui.panelSettingsDescription: Port, remote access, and panel updates.
ui.portUsed: Port used to access the panel (default: {{port}}).
ui.portChangesRestart: Port changes require a restart. Save first, then restart.
ui.panelRestartingOnPort: Panel is restarting on port {{port}}. Reconnecting...
ui.themeDescription: Choose between the gritty survival look or a clean light theme.
ui.corsDescription: Controls which devices and browsers can connect to this panel. If you only access the panel from this machine, these defaults are fine.
ui.allowPrivateLanDescription: Automatically allow connections from localhost and private/LAN IP ranges.
ui.showPublicIpDescription: Look up this machine's public IP (via api.ipify.org) to display on the dashboard. Off by default — an unnecessary external dependency and small privacy leak for LAN-only setups. The result is cached, so this calls out at most once per restart.
ui.dashboardLanAddressDescription: Which network interface's address the dashboard shows. Useful when this host has more than one, e.g. Tailscale and ZeroTier at once — pick the one you actually want to share with players.
ui.oneOriginPerLine: One address per line, including http:// or https:// and port if needed.
ui.allowAllOriginsDebugDescription: Skip all origin checks — useful for diagnosing connection problems.
ui.enableCorsDebugDescription: Log blocked connection attempts for troubleshooting.
ui.allowAllOriginsWarning: Allowing all origins removes browser-origin protection. Use this only for short troubleshooting windows.
ui.modUpdateSettingsDescription: How often to check for Workshop updates and whether to auto-restart when updates arrive.
ui.checkIntervalDescription: Check every 1-120 minutes. Changes take effect as soon as you save.
ui.autoRestartOnModUpdateDescription: Automatically restart the server when mod updates are detected
ui.restartDelayDescription: Players are warned before the restart happens.
ui.apiKeysDescription: Keys used for Steam Workshop lookups and the server finder.
ui.steamApiKeyDescription: Used for Steam Workshop mod information and server finder features.
ui.howToGetSteamApiKey: How to get a Steam API Key:
ui.enterSteamApiDomain: Enter a domain name (can be "localhost" for personal use)
ui.worldBackupsDescription: Save and restore your server's world, map, and player data.
ui.scheduledBackupsDescription: Automatically back up your world on a schedule
ui.cronDescription: Default: every 6 hours. Uses cron format: minute hour day month weekday.
ui.maxBackupsDescription: The panel deletes the oldest backups when this limit is reached.
ui.securityAuthenticationDescription: Change your password and review access details.
ui.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 6 characters
ui.recoveryWhenPasswordLost: Recovery when the current password is lost
ui.localPasswordRecoveryDescription: This panel session is running from the server itself, so you can reset the password here without typing the current one.
ui.preRestoreBackupCreated: A pre-restore backup will be created
ui.deleteBackupConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
ui.corsLockoutDescription: Disabling {{privateOrigins}} with no explicit origins listed and {{allOrigins}} off will block every browser connection, including the one you are using right now, after the next CORS reload.
ui.corsLockoutRecovery: To recover, restart the panel with the
ui.corsLockoutRecoverySuffix: environment variable set to a valid origin
ui.corsLockoutOriginHint: Add at least one origin in the box above first, then disable LAN access.
ui.pendingEdits: You have pending edits. Save changes to apply them to the live panel.
ui.corsQuickAddOrigin: 2. Add one origin per line below (example:
ui.panelAutoUpdateDescription: Check for a new release, download it, then apply it on restart.
ui.originTooLong: Origin is too long ({{length}} characters). Maximum is {{max}}.
ui.httpsRecommendedStep: Enable HTTPS, leave certificate paths empty, save, then restart.
ui.httpsAutoCertificate: The panel creates a local self-signed certificate automatically.
ui.certificatePathsDescription: Set both certificate and key paths, or leave both empty.
ui.keyPathDescription: Supports PEM key files that Node.js can read.
ui.provideBothCertificateFilesDescription: Set both certificate and key paths, or clear both to use auto-generated certificates.
ui.autoGeneratedCertificateDescription: The panel will create and reuse a local self-signed certificate.
ui.reverseProxyDescription: If TLS is terminated by Nginx, Caddy, or Cloudflare Tunnel, keep panel HTTPS off and proxy local HTTP.
ui.httpsRestartDescription: HTTPS changes require a restart. Save first, then restart from Panel Settings.
ui.rconDescription: Test the connection and set reconnect behavior. Host, port, and password are configured per server on the Servers page.
ui.passwordRecoveryUnavailable: The panel cannot show existing passwords. If you still have filesystem access to the panel host, sign out and either create
ui.passwordRecoveryTokenDescription: Once the token file exists, the login screen will show a recovery option so you can set a new admin password without knowing the old one.
ui.rconSecurityDescription: Your RCON password is stored locally and is never transmitted outside of the RCON connection to your server.
ui.adminCommandsDescription: Be careful with admin commands. Some actions like banning or kicking players cannot be easily undone.
ui.authenticationNotConfigured: Authentication is not configured. Create an account via the setup wizard on first launch to protect access to this panel.
ui.aboutDescription: Panel version, runtime info, and helpful links.
ui.aboutProductDescription: A web-based management panel for Project Zomboid dedicated servers. Includes RCON, player management, mod update detection, scheduled restarts, world backups, Discord integration, and the PanelBridge Lua mod for in-world actions.
ui.supportDescription: Support development to keep updates and new features coming.
ui.updateStillRunningPreviousWithFile: Panel is still running v{{current}}.{{expected}} The downloaded file is still on disk; you can retry the restart.
ui.updateStillRunningPreviousMissingFile: Panel is still running v{{current}}.{{expected}} The staged binary is gone; download the update again before retrying.
ui.antivirusDeletedBinary: Antivirus or Controlled Folder Access deleted the new binary after it was placed.
ui.addFolderToAvExclusions: Add this folder to your AV exclusions and retry:
ui.renameLockedDescription: Another process (OneDrive, AV, or a file watcher) held the executable locked. Pause OneDrive or close Explorer windows pointing at the folder, then retry.
ui.permissionDescription: Access was denied while writing to the panel folder. Relaunch the panel as Administrator or move it out of Program Files.
ui.helperBlockedDescription: The update helper script was blocked from running (Windows Defender ASR, AppLocker, or Group Policy). The staged binary is still on disk.
ui.startBatRecovery: close this panel and double-click Start.bat in:
ui.startBatRecoveryDescription: Start.bat picks the newest binary automatically, so the update will apply. To prevent this in the future, add the panel folder to AV exclusions.
ui.noHelperLogDescription: The helper script may have been blocked by execution policy or antivirus. Check Windows Defender protection history.
ui.dockerUpdateDescription: The panel will save and stop Project Zomboid through RCON, then rebuild and recreate the all-in-one container. Players will be disconnected while the panel comes back online.
ui.panelUpdateExitDescription: The panel will exit immediately. A helper process will swap the executable and relaunch it in a few seconds.{{version}}
ui.helperLogRecoveryHint: If the new version does not come back online within a minute, check the helper log in
ui.saveBeforeUpdate: Save settings before applying an update.
ui.updateFilesReady: Update files are ready. Restart to switch to the new version.
ui.dockerUpdateReadyDescription: Applying this update saves and stops Project Zomboid, then rebuilds and recreates the all-in-one container.
ui.downloadThenRestart: Download the update, then restart to apply it.
ui.noUpdateReady: No update is ready to install.
ui.dockerUpdatesHostController: Docker updates are handled by the configured host controller.
ui.autoUpdatePackagedOnly: Auto-update works in packaged builds only. In dev mode, update from git.
ui.httpsDescription: Encrypt panel traffic with a TLS certificate.

collection.autoSyncDescription: When you track or untrack a mod, the panel updates the collection in the background. Failures are logged but don't block your action.

collection.sendCookies: Click {{action}}. From now on, refreshes take one click.
collection.privacyDescription: The extension only talks to steamcommunity.com to read your sessionid and steamLoginSecure cookies, and to the panel URL you configured. Your password is {{not}} stored unless you explicitly enable Remember password; by default only a short-lived access token is cached.
collection.quickSetup: Quick setup: paste a Steam request

collection.cookieExporterDescription: The open-source Chrome/Firefox exporter works well on Steam. Open steamcommunity.com while signed in, copy the result, and paste it below; both {{netscape}} and {{header}} formats are understood.
